from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyCashAmount(BaseModel):
    """Cash and cash equivalents reported by one company in their financial statement."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company name from the filing")
    cash_line_label: str | None = Field(description="The exact line-item label as written (e.g. 'Cash', 'Cash and cash equivalents')")
    cash_amount: float | None = Field(description="The cash amount as reported")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="How the amount is expressed: 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions'")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The period the figure covers")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim line containing the label and amount")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_cash_amounts: list[CompanyCashAmount]
